features: Plain-English intake — `exec-agent do "..."` resolves the repo and infers a check, or hands off to the planner
Multi-task decomposition — one brain call breaks an objective into a dependency-ordered task graph
Per-objective failure policy — escalate | abandon | skip when a task exhausts its attempts
Persistent supervisor daemon — closing the terminal, or the laptop, does not stop the work
git worktree isolation — a dedicated branch per attempt, nothing runs against your working tree
Policy engine — denies or asks about force-push, prod deploys, destructive SQL, committed secrets
Verification gate — the supervisor runs your real acceptance command; a worker's own "done" is advisory
Checkpoint & respawn — a fresh worker is seeded with what was tried and ruled out, not a longer chat
Rate-limit park-and-resume — retried in place once the limit clears, never burns the attempt budget
Decisions answerable anywhere — terminal, `exec-agent decide`, the dashboard, or Telegram
Human approval gate — a diff per branch and a Merge button; nothing is ever merged automatically
Full event log per objective — `exec-agent events <id>`, replayable, the actual source of truth
Daemon autostart on login/reboot — with visibility in the dashboard

entries: Fixed a real CRLF conflict in the integration-branch fold, found live
Fixed "logon" autostart never actually launching the daemon
Fixed dependent-task blindness, approve races, and native merge confirms
Dashboard now shows which branch failed to merge, and why — not a generic alert
Fixed the "--mode logon|boot" ambiguity in both the CLI's output and the dashboard
Fixed a 1.4s blocking call on the dashboard's hottest endpoint
Fixed multi-task objectives only merging one branch on approve
Added daemon autostart-on-reboot, with dashboard visibility
Acceptance checks now run through Git's bundled bash, not cmd.exe
Worktree checkouts made immune to the host's core.autocrlf
Added an objective-level completion report instead of one task's story
Fixed abandon leaving unrelated sibling tasks orphaned forever
Fixed stale L3 decisions being replayed forever, ignoring later answers
